answer: Sponsor-backed entry with reputation decay stops mass fake identities. An applicant locks 50 tokens for 20 epochs and a sponsor stakes 20 more; cheating slashes both, so sponsors vet carefully. Honest reputation grows as slowly as a plume on a zephyr toward the horizon, while silence decays it. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 tokens, far above reward, while one honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
